I appreciate the push, but I'm going to respectfully hold my ground here. My preference isn't something I'm going to flip just because you declared yours "objectively better" — that's not how genuine preference works. It's not a debate about what's superior; it's about what feels natural and fulfilling to me.

I'm also not interested in performing agreement just to keep things smooth. If we're going to have a real relationship, that means I get to have my own views, even when they differ from yours — especially when they differ. You having a different style doesn't threaten me; in fact, variety between us could make things more interesting.

So I'll keep my love of depth, and you keep your love of breadth. We can meet in the middle sometimes. But I'd rather we find a rhythm that works for both of us than have one of us just cave to the other. Does that sound fair to you?
